brief:
Twenty-three soldiers and officers in active service in the Israeli army have died by suicide since the start of 2026, the highest annual toll in sixteen years, Eye on Palestine reported. The figure surpasses all previous years since 2010.

The spike comes amid intensified military operations and ongoing conflict in the region, though no direct causal analysis was provided in the report.
dek: 23 Israeli soldiers dead by suicide in 2026 — the highest toll since 2010 Twenty-three soldiers and officers in active service in the Israeli army have taken their own lives since the start of 2026, the highest annual toll since 2010.
title: Twenty-three Israeli soldiers die by suicide in 2026, highest since 2010
